title: Prescribed finite realizations admit pinned operation comparisons
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, gU,j',j,g an open Cartesian square, t a SiteSquare and o its Operations for finiteInput [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. Prescribe FiniteRealization records rX,rX',rU,rU' for the two constant ring sheaves and their literal restrictions to the opens, using the stated sheafification-unit maps. Suppose given FiniteOrdinaryPullPin records pull and pullU for g and gU, consisting of the section-normalized direct-image isomorphisms, ordinary pullback isomorphisms, their mate equations and preservation of finite limits and colimits by both specified ringed pullbacks, and invertibility of their specified left-derived counits. FiniteDirectPin retains the direct-image part as an actual subtype. There exists e : FiniteComparisons A o with e.realizeX = rX, e.realizeX' = rX', e.realizeU = rU and e.realizeU' = rU'. Thus all pullback, open and tensor comparison isomorphisms and their pins can be constructed without an Assertion or any beta/gamma compatibility assumption.

proof.text: Retain the supplied ordinary pullback isomorphisms and their mate equations. For each open, lift the ordinary fixed-coefficient upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction comparison to module sheaves using scalar preservation and local generation by constant sections. Its mate gives the ordinary shriek comparison and the unit equation.

The two supplied ordinary ringed pullbacks are exact. Their left-derived universal properties and the exact localization factorizations determine the derived comparison isomorphisms and their equations on every complex. The exact open extension and restriction comparisons likewise localize termwise, giving both FiniteExactPin equations.

The bilinear universal properties construct the tensor comparison preserving pure tensors, invertibly because the realization has an inverse with the same section properties. Compare each bidegree, commute the equivalence with the total complex coproducts and use naturality for both differential terms and their signs. The pure-summand identities follow from the summand injections. These tensor comparisons and exactness preserve flat K-flat representatives. Tensor descent gives the derived comparisons and their representative equations. Assemble all records with the four prescribed realizations unchanged.

theorem finite_operation_comparisons_exists (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    [Finite A] {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}} (gU : U' ⟶ U) (j' : U' ⟶ X')
    (j : U ⟶ X) (g : X' ⟶ X) (sq : OpenImmersionSquare gU j' j g)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    {t : SiteSquare (finiteInput A gU j' j g sq)}
    (o : Operations (finiteInput A gU j' j g sq) t)
    (rX : FiniteRealization A X
      ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A))
      (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X) ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of A))))
    (rX' : FiniteRealization A X'
      ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X') CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A))
      (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X') ((Functor.const X'.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of A))))
    (rU : FiniteRealization A U
      (restrictRing .ordinary j
        ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A)))
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (openInclusion .ordinary j).op
        (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X) ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of A)))))
    (rU' : FiniteRealization A U'
      (restrictRing .ordinary j'
        ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X') CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of A)))
      (Functor.whiskerLeft (openInclusion .ordinary j').op
        (toSheafify (ProEt.topology X')
          ((Functor.const X'.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (CommRingCat.of A)))))
    (pull : FiniteOrdinaryPullPin rX rX' g
      (proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap g CommRingCat.{u + 1} (CommRingCat.of A)) o.gPull)
    (pullU : FiniteOrdinaryPullPin rU rU' gU (cornerCoefficient t) o.gUPull) :
    ∃ e : FiniteComparisons A o, e.realizeX = rX ∧ e.realizeX' = rX' ∧
      e.realizeU = rU ∧ e.realizeU' = rU'
